title: 새벽 3시 33분
summary: 신입 연구원 도진은 첫 출근 날, 격리실 CCTV에서 자신과 똑같은 얼굴의 존재를 발견한다.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Extreme wide shot, slow dolly in. [dojin] walking straight down the corridor. sterile white corridors, flickering fluorescent lights. harsh overhead fluorescent lighting, clinical white and pale gray color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Medium close-up, static camera. [dojin] adjusting his silver ID badge on his chest. cold stainless steel containment cells, brushed metal texture. cold industrial lighting, high-contrast shadows.

scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Wide shot, static camera. [dojin] watching the black-and-white screen intently. cold stainless steel room, peeling paint on corners. low-key surveillance lighting, high-contrast monochrome.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Medium shot, slow push in. [dojin] squinting eyes at the monitor. sterile white interior, dust particles floating in the air. dim monitor glow, sickly green color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Close-up, static camera. [dojin] freezing completely in place. cracked monitor screen, static noise. harsh screen backlighting, cold blue color grading.

scenes.speaker: dojin
scenes.shot: Medium close-up, handheld camera. [dojin] pointing trembling finger at the glass. sterile white control room, smooth metal console. flickering fluorescent lights, nervous cold color grading.

scenes.speaker: sojin

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Extreme close-up, slow dolly in. [dojin] opening mouth in silent shock. grainy CRT display, scan lines visible. eerie green glow, dark cinematic color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Close-up, slow push in. [dojin] sweating profusely on the forehead. sterile white desk, cold metallic reflection. harsh overhead lighting, deep shadow contrast.

scenes.speaker: dojin

scenes.speaker: doctorlee
scenes.shot: Medium shot, slow pan left. [doctorlee] writing slowly on a clipboard. stained white lab coat, wrinkled paper texture. dim desk lamp lighting, sepia shadow grading.

scenes.speaker: sojin
scenes.shot: Medium close-up, fast push in. [sojin] aiming sidearm directly forward. tactical black combat gear, heavy strap details. harsh directional lighting, cold metallic color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Wide shot, frantic handheld camera. [dojin] covering ears with both hands. sterile white corridor, red emergency lights flashing. pulsating crimson alarm lighting, high-contrast red color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Medium shot, slow tilt down. [dojin] backing away slowly against the wall. heavy steel door, hydraulic piston mechanisms. flashing red emergency strobe, stark crimson color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Close-up, static camera. [dojin] trembling visibly without moving. scratched steel floor, metallic dust particles. dim emergency lighting, deep shadow contrast.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Medium wide shot, slow dolly in. [dojin] staring blankly into the darkness. cold stainless steel doorway, foggy condensation on glass. flickering red warning lights, claustrophobic dark grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Extreme close-up, slow zoom in. [dojin] widening eyes in total terror. pale skin texture, dark circles under eyes. high-contrast side lighting, chilling blue and red color grading.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Close-up, static camera. [dojin] holding breath completely still. digital wall clock, glowing red numbers. harsh digital clock glow, pitch black background.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Medium close-up, freezing frame. [dojin] stopping all movement instantly. sterile white corridor, cold steel panels. dim overhead lighting, chilling psychological horror grading.

cta: 내일 새벽 3시 33분, 진짜 도진은 누구인가? 지금 바로 구독하고 다음 진실을 확인하세요.
description: SCP 재단 한국 지부, 매일 새벽 3시 33분 격리실 CCTV에 존재하지 않는 연구원이 찍힌다. 신입 도진은 모니터 속에서 자신의 얼굴을 마주하고 경악한다. [SCP Foundation CC BY-SA 3.0]
